svg.title: ODDCHAPTER — OC monogram concepts
svg.text: Concepts for approval. Every mark below is exact vector geometry, authored on a 100-unit grid — no raster lettering.
Two equal rings. The crossing is knocked out, so each letter
passes through the other instead of sitting beside it.
Single colour by construction — no accent needed.
Compact vertical ligature; strongest recognition in a square
or circular crop. The Signal Orange rule is the joint.
Only the rule carries colour, keeping orange as an accent.
OFFSET AXIS / ACCENT ON THE OPEN LETTER
Two letters of equal weight on an offset axis, joined at a
shallow junction so the pair reads as one moving unit.
Accent sits on the open letter — orange marks the opening.
No logo, avatar, banner or template has been produced yet.
Construction: circular arcs on a 100 × 100 unit grid · Wordmark outlined from Space Grotesk (SIL Open Font Licence) · Vector only — no generated raster used as a master.
